main_body: Market stall: striped awning on top, a shelf with produce behind, a wooden counter with vegetables on it, and a wooden front panel with a stone base
top_band: Counter top at rows 26-29: a lighter brown surface (highlight #b77541 at row 26, then #885a26 at rows 27-29), about 4 rows, sitting above the darker front face (L~49-65). The awning above is a separate striped roof band.
evidence: In the column scan, the counter top (L 98-131) is clearly lighter than the front panel (L 49-65), a step of 35 or more. It reads as a horizontal surface carrying produce, with a front edge, then a darker front face of rows 30-40 with a central panel seam, then a stone base. The construction matches the reference stall: awning roof above, counter top band, front face below. The awning is the same kind of drawn roof as the references use. No receding side face is drawn. The top band is short but sufficient, and the produce props confirm it reads as a surface seen from above.

style.evidence: The candidate has 37 distinct colours and a median of 20 colours per tile, in line with the references (17 and 20). Flat-fill coverage is 13%, the same as the cheese stall. Only 1% of dark edge pixels are neutral, so the outlines are tinted: dark brown beside wood, dark green beside leaves. The awning stripes use 3-4 greens plus cream shading, the wood counter has grain dots and highlights, and the produce is detailed. Overall it sits at the level of the Beodeul stall references and would not look flatter or more sticker-like next to them.
